hyperparameters.selection_protocol: all settings fixed a priori; GP designated primary before scoring; MLP nested tuning as the declared exception

ei_oracle.label: EI, oracle stop
ei_oracle.regret_note: zero by construction, the run stops when the best condition is queried

ei_realizable.label: EI, realizable stop
ei_realizable.rule: stop after 3 consecutive rounds with max EI < 1% of current best

random.label: Random sampling, oracle stop
random.regret_note: zero by construction, sampling continues until the best condition is drawn

meta.regret_units: V (V_rms), best measured minus best found
